description:
All the good stuff from our Vedder gravelbike, but tailored to bigger 32” wheels.

We have been fantasizing and sketching about a dropbar with bigger wheels for some years, but the lack of good tyres stopped us from building a frame. Now that Schwalbe came out with their excellent G-one RX we can finally build our fantasy. Taking clues from years of building custom gravelbikes, mountainbikes and touringbikes and experimenting with geometry we have finetuned this 32” Vedder for it’s bigger wheels making sure it is as much fun as it is fast.

Vedder 32 is available in titanium and steel with 3D printed yokes and dropouts. For titanium the standard finish is blasted prints, brushed tubing and a polished and anodised front in a color of your choice. Full polished finishes are available at a surcharge.

For steel we offer any RAL color powdercoat and some special colors at a surcharge. Custom paint is also possible.

Vedder 32 comes standard with internal routing (nót through the headset!) and mounts for 2 bottlecages. Other mounts are optional at a surcharge.

Vedder is (of course) UDH and Transmission compatible and standard 160mm flatmount.

Bottom bracket is the excellent internal T47 at 86.5mm wide and the frame will fit a 46t wide/XPLR chainring.

Every Vedder is handmade to measure in our workshop in Wijchen, the Netherlands.
